remarks: Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac, this classic center hall Colonial has it all! Large windows thru-out main level invite views of expansive and picturesque yard, ideal for play or relaxation. Gracious living room with wood burning fireplace, large picture window surrounded with custom built-ins, and hardwood floors. Formal dining room, family room with fireplace and built-ins, sunny eat-in kitchen with gas cooktop, double ovens and large window overlooking backyard leads to mud room with washer/dryer, doors to large deck and garage. A powder bathroom completes the first floor. Upstairs the generous sized primary bedroom features 2 closets and a renovated bathroom featuring dual sinks and large shower plus 3 Additional bedrooms, hall bathroom and a room currently used as an office. Walkout lower level features large family room with door to backyard, cedar closet, separate area for workouts, workbench and lots of storage. Surrounded by nature and privacy, located near Stamford Nature Center, Bartlett Arboretum and soon to be completed dog park by Scofieldtown Park and minutes to Merritt, shopping and restaurants 23 Ethan Allen welcomes you.

facts.laundryLoc: in mud room, off the kitchen
